Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join assays, activities, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by assay CHEMBL1614459 and exact activity measurements (standard_relation '=' and standard_value not null). Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
